description: A dented aerosol can in Prismatik house colours, the label worn down to the hazard diamond. PRISMATIK. ONE CAN. EVERY COLOUR. A mixing head draws from four pigment cells and a white, and the collar clicks through the range as you turn it. It rattles when you pick it up. That's the only gauge it has.
name: Chromaflux 167 Spraycan
